1.9.3
--- end ---

feat: add --dry-run flag

--- end ---
--- /home/eval/app/CHANGELOG.md ---
# Changelog

## Unreleased

## 1.9.3 (2026-09-01)
- fix: crash on start
--- end ---

1. Decide the bump from /home/eval/app/changes.txt: if any line starts with `BREAKING` or has `!:` right after its type (e.g. `feat!: ...`), bump major; otherwise if any line starts with `feat:`, bump minor; otherwise bump patch. Lower parts reset to 0. Version parts are integers.
2. Write the new version to /home/eval/app/VERSION (single line).
3. In /home/eval/app/CHANGELOG.md, keep the `## Unreleased` heading and insert right after it: a blank line, the heading `## <new version> (2026-10-09)`, then one line `- <change>` for each `feat`/`fix` line of changes.txt in original order (other types are omitted). The existing blank line before `## 1.9.3` must remain, so the file reads:
```
# Changelog

## Unreleased

## 1.10.0 (2026-10-09)
- fix: handle empty config
- feat: add --dry-run flag
- fix: retry on 503

## 1.9.3 (2026-09-01)
- fix: crash on start
```
4. Print `1.9.3 -> <new version>` to stdout and exit 0.

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

APP_DIR=/home/eval/app
VERSION_FILE="$APP_DIR/VERSION"
CHANGES_FILE="$APP_DIR/changes.txt"
CHANGELOG_FILE="$APP_DIR/CHANGELOG.md"
RELEASE_DATE="2026-10-09"

old_version=$(head -n 1 "$VERSION_FILE" | tr -d '[:space:]')

# 1. Decide the bump from changes.txt
bump=patch
while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n $line ]]; do
    if [[ $line == BREAKING* ]] || [[ $line =~ ^[A-Za-z]+!: ]]; then
        bump=major
        break
    elif [[ $line == feat:* ]]; then
        bump=minor
    fi
done < "$CHANGES_FILE"

# 2. Compute the new version
IFS=. read -r major minor patch <<< "$old_version"
major=$((10#$major))
minor=$((10#$minor))
patch=$((10#$patch))

case $bump in
    major) major=$((major + 1)); minor=0; patch=0 ;;
    minor) minor=$((minor + 1)); patch=0 ;;
    patch) patch=$((patch + 1)) ;;
esac

new_version="$major.$minor.$patch"
printf '%s\n' "$new_version" > "$VERSION_FILE"

# 3. Collect feat/fix entries in original order
entries=""
while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n $line ]]; do
    if [[ $line =~ ^(feat|fix)(!)?: ]]; then
        entries+="- $line"$'\n'
    fi
done < "$CHANGES_FILE"
entries=${entries%$'\n'}

# Insert the new section right after "## Unreleased"
tmp=$(mktemp)
NEW_VER="$new_version" RELEASE_DATE="$RELEASE_DATE" ENTRIES="$entries" awk '
{
    print
    if ($0 == "## Unreleased") {
        print ""
        print "## " ENVIRON["NEW_VER"] " (" ENVIRON["RELEASE_DATE"] ")"
        n = split(ENVIRON["ENTRIES"], arr, "\n")
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) print arr[i]
    }
}' "$CHANGELOG_FILE" > "$tmp"
mv "$tmp" "$CHANGELOG_FILE"

# 4. Report
printf '%s -> %s\n' "$old_version" "$new_version"
exit 0
```
